arguments.summary:
Implemented invoice-paid webhook handling and notification dispatch.

Changes:
- src/common/events.py: Added INVOICE_PAID = "billing.invoice.paid" event constant.
- src/notifications/templates.py: Added TEMPLATE_INVOICE_PAID = "invoice_paid" template constant.
- src/billing/webhooks.py: BillingWebhookController.receive now parses the verified JSON payload and, when type == "billing.invoice.paid", publishes an INVOICE_PAID EventEnvelope carrying the data payload (invoice_id, customer_email, amount). Existing signature verification and the default PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_ACCEPTED/retry behavior are preserved.
- src/notifications/dispatcher.py: NotificationDispatcher.handle now sends the invoice_paid template to the customer_email from the INVOICE_PAID event payload.

Verification: task test (tests/task_verification/test_f04.py) and full regression suite (tests/) both pass.
